### Red team · Question

Event: `54b0c93d7dbaf7cd60645db3dfcd7d7c` · 2026-09-26T03:16:59Z

> Verdict: MERGE. My r3 P2-1 and P3-1 are both closed.
> 
> One decoder: the CallFromUMode arm is system_call(pid, regs) -> !, which calls only redoubt::handle, and syscall.rs is deleted. SysCall is no longer imported in irq.rs. Every a0 outside the table gives InvalidArgument.
> OD7: CallFromSMode goes to sched::switch, which asserts current_pid == KERNEL_PID and a0 == SWITCH_TAG. A U-mode ecall with SWITCH_TAG reaches redoubt::handle and is refused (a legacy-gone row). The S-mode arm skips expire_at_entry and billing; that is correct, since only kmain can take it.
> Residuals: SwitchTo, Shutdown, Yield/WaitEvent, SWITCHTO_CALLER, ORIGINAL_PID/TID and set_last_thread are all gone (grep finds none). kmain switches to the exact (pid, tid) it picked, so the borrowed-quantum residual is closed. The exception-handler state and ppid are gone. The PID-1 tests that remain (sched.rs 138/241/259/291, irq.rs resume, mem.rs is_kernel, intc_plic) identify the kernel itself. The loader numbers user PIDs from 2, so they grant no user authority. EXCEPTION_TID and IRQ_TID are still reserved, which the plan owns at commit 9 (OD10).
> 
> Plant (rv64, scratch worktree at d00a3c501, reverted and removed): system_call answered a0 == 23 (Shutdown) with success. legacy-gone FAIL: 'a0 = 0x17 was not refused as unknown'. Reverted: legacy-gone PASS on rv64 and rv32. The implementer's recorded negative run on 7c (FAIL at a0 = 0) also stands.
> 
> P3-1 sched::switch does `pid as u8` before PID::new. kmain is the only caller and passes a real PID, so this is harmless. A u8::try_from would make a kernel bug panic instead of wrapping.
